title: EUDI Attribute Attestation Mapper
description: Map KYC/onboarding attributes to EUDI Wallet PID + (Q)EAA attestation categories under eIDAS 2.0 (Reg (EU) 2024/1183). Covers selective disclosure, AML CDD mapping. EUDI Wallet availability by 31 Dec 2026.

mcp_tool_definition.name: eudi_attribute_attestation_mapper
mcp_tool_definition.description: Map KYC attributes to EUDI Wallet PID / (Q)EAA attestations under eIDAS 2.0 (Reg (EU) 2024/1183). Browser-based, zero PII.
